title: The War on Ukraine
body:
Zelenskys request for jets would have definitely shortened the war but he was denied.

 According to the New York Post 3-24-2022: Ukraine’s request for additional fighter jets has
been a hotly contested issue among the NATO alliance. Ukraine flies some of the same
Soviet-era MiG fighter jets that are still in service in Slovakia and Poland, both NATO member
states. But both countries — and the alliance as a whole — have expressed concerns that
providing fighter jets to Ukraine will be seen as an act of war by Russia.
 White House press secretary Jen Psaki struggled to explain why the Biden administration
continues to reject Poland’s offer to send MiG-29 jet fighters to Ukraine despite President
Volodymyr Zelensky’s repeated pleas for the warplanes to help his country repel the Russian
invasion. 3/15/2022
WHAT! Providing jets for defense can be considered as an act of war? What? It is obvious to
me that this gaslighting is all about perpetual war and the flow of money out of the United
States into the hands of the super rich well connected corrupt, the constant pilfering and
economic enslavement of the people in the United States.
